tei:div.tei:p: ༁ྃ: zab chos zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol las: bka' srung dam can sde bdun chos skyong kun 'dus kyi mdangs bskang gdug pa rang grol zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

oṃ āḥhūm̐: kun bzang che mchog zhi khro rab 'byams dang : mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la 'dud: dam can sde bdun chos skyong kun 'dus kyi: mdangs bskang gdug pa rang grol 'dir bshad bya: mchod rdzas bskang rdzas tshogs par bshams nas su: dam can sgos mchod srung ma spyi bskang gnyis: dang po dam can sgos su mchod pa ni: hūm̐: ma hā kā la thugs dam can: khyed la mchod pa 'bul ba ni: rin chen snod dam bhandha ru: bshos nag 'bar ba khrag gis byug: tsitta snying gi rgyal mtshan btsugs: g.yag lug nag po khyi yis mtshan: dgra bo'i sha rus thod tshal spungs: rakta dmar gyi zham chu 'bab: dam rdzas gtor chen 'bar ba 'dis: dpal mgon nag po'i thugs dam bskang : bdud rtsi sman gtor rakta dang : sha sna snying sna khrag sna dang : chibs rta 'gel g.yag rten lug dang : bing dang ru mtshon gsang ba'i rdzas: mthun rdzas du mas thugs dam bskang : ma ning nag po mched gsum gyi: thugs dam gnyan po bskang gyur cig: hūm̐: dpal ldan sngags kyi srung ma la: mthun pa'i rdzas kyis bskang ba ni: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma dang : bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa dang : rakta dmar gyi arghaṃ dang : zhun chen mar me gsur dud dang : zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa yis: smug nag 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: yum mchog lha mo dpal 'bar ma: khyed kyi thugs dam bskang ba ni: sha khrag dmar gtor rakta dang : khyad par mthun pa nal bu'i rdzas: mthing gi gur dang rakta'i mtsho: mi rta'i sha khrag dron mo yis: yum mchog lha mo 'khor dang bcas: ma mo yongs kyi thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: shan pa srog bdag 'khor dang bcas: khyed dang mthun pa'i dam rdzas ni: dpal gtor sha khrag dmar gyis brgyan: spos dang zhun chen mar me dang : dgra bo'i sha khrag glo snying ni: khrag 'dzag dron mo rlangs pa 'thul: klad khrag rus par bcas pa yis: srog bdag 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : hūm̐:

gza' bdud nag po 'khor bcas la: dmar gtor bshos bu dgus bskor dang : dgra bo'i sha khrag rus pa dang : me tog stong dang chu sna stong : sman sna stong dang sha sna stong : snying sna stong dang khrag sna stong : gsur chen rol mo sna tshogs kyis: drang srong 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: dam can skyes bu chen po yi: khyed kyi thugs dam bskang ba ni: mkhar thabs bshos bu ra yis mtshan: sha khrag dmar gtor rakta dang : ra yi sha khrag gsur chen dang : smyug rgod khrab byang rnga khrab dang : mdzes pa'i glu gar rol mo dang : mthun rdzas du mas thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: gnod sbyin dmar nag 'khor bcas la: mthun pa'i dam rdzas bshos bu dang : phyi mchod rin chen sna lnga dang : nang mchod bdud rtsi rnam lnga dang : gsang mchod sman raka gtor gsum dang : sha khrag 'dod yon rnam lnga dang : sil snyan glu gar rol mo dbyangs: spyan gzigs dkor chas thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: gzhan yang dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs: sngags bdag sde dpon sum cu dang : gter srung brtan ma bcu gnyis dang : dge bsnyen nyer gcig gzhi bdag dang : gzhan yang slob dpon padma yi: spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas pa'i: dge bsnyen yul lha gzhi bdag rnams: spos dang mar mes thugs dam bskang : sman raka gtor gsum thugs dam bskang : mthun rdzas du mas thugs dam bskang : thugs dam skongs la phrin las mdzod: de nas bka' srung dam can spyi yi bskang ba ni: kye: dgongs shig dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs: ma hā kā la dgongs su gsol: ma ning nag po dgongs su gsaul: lha chen dpal 'bar dgongs su gsol: srog bdud nag po dgongs su gsol: me dbal nag po dgongs su gsol: dpal ldan sngags srung dgongs su gsol: yum mchog lha mo dgongs su gsol: shan pa srog bdag dgongs su gsol: gza' bdud nag po dgongs su gsol: rdo rje legs pa dgongs su gsol: gnod sbyin dmar nag dgongs su gsol:

dam can rgya mtsho dgongs su gsol: brtan ma bcu gnyis dgongs su gsol: kye: do nub dpal gyi dam zhig bsre: do nub snga ma'i gtang rag gtong : do nub phyi ma'i zhu don 'bul: do nub las kyi gnyer zhig gtad: do nub nyams chag zhig ral gso: do nub thugs dam gnyan po bskang : do nub mnyes pa'i zas shig 'dren: zas kyi ngo zhig khyod kyis mdzod: chad pa'i gzhung ni nga yis bsrang : bcol ba'i las 'di khyod kyis mdzod: gnyis ka las kyi gnyer blangs 'tshal: srung ma dam can khyed rnams kyang : rgyang nge ring nge ma mdzad par: brtse gdung gdung sems che bar mdzod: gtad do gnyer ro thugs dam can: gsol lo mchod do srung ma'i tshogs: phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: yang cig dpal gyi thugs dam bskang : dam can rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang : dregs pa pho mo'i thugs dam bskang : 'bod pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir: g.yab dar nag pos thugs dam bskang : brten pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir: phyar dar nag pos thugs dam bskang : bzhugs pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir: nyi zla padmas= dgyes pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir: dmar chen gtor mas= mthun pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir: sha sna snying snas= btung ba'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir: rakta khrag snas= bgo ba'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir: zhing chen g.yang gzhis= rgyan gyi dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir: thod phreng mi mgos= 'bod pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir: rkang gling thod rngas= drag po'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir: thun dang zor gyis= khyad par dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir: gri rgod snying gis= dam tshig gnyan po bsre ba'i phyir: bdud rtsi sman gyis= shangs kyi mchod pa yin pa'i phyir: gsur chen dud pas= dbang dang dngos grub blangs ba'i phyir: zhal zas tshogs kyis= rnal 'byor dam tshig bskang ba'i phyir: 'dod yon lnga yis= dug lnga gnas su gzhom pa'i phyir: su ra chang gis= spyan gyi mchod pa yin pa'i phyir:

spyan gzigs dkor chas= snyan gyi dbang po tshim bya'i phyir: rol mo sgra yis= rtag tu mi 'bral 'grogs pa'i phyir: rtag gtor chen pos= rgyun du phrin las bcol ba'i phyir: rgyun gtor nar mas= dam nyams dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i phyir: 'khor tshogs sprul pa'i= bskang gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: g.yar dam skong la rkyen dbang zlog: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: zab chos zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol gyi: bka' srung dam can sde bdun gyi mdangs bskang gdug pa rang grol zhes bya ba 'di ni: lug lo khyi yi zla ba'i yar tshes bzang pau la: nam mkha' rgya mtshos dpal rin chen gling du bris pas 'gro ba sems can thams cad kyi zab chos 'di nyid la longs spyod nas mthar thug sku gsum lhun grub kyi 'bras bu thob par gyur cig:
